title: Getting Started With Agents: Set Up Sales Order Agent - New 'Try it out' experience (2026)

chapters.title: Try It Out: Creating Test Tasks

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An agent in Business Central that monitors sales orders and sales inquiries and helps process them from customer emails.
caveats: Requires human review before sending any email out of Business Central
Does not process emails from unknown customers without review if configured that way
Cannot send email if inbox is not connected

features.name: Try It Out Experience
features.description: A new feature that allows users to create test tasks and experiment with the sales order agent without connecting to a real inbox, using predefined templates or manual text entry.
caveats: Non-relevant attachments can be filtered by the agent

features.name: Email Attachment Detection
features.description: The agent can identify and process email attachments, automatically filtering out non-relevant ones such as terms and conditions or privacy policies.
caveats: Filtering is automatic but can mark documents as non-relevant based on content recognition

features.name: Customer Identification
features.description: The agent automatically identifies the customer from the incoming email and matches it to existing contacts in the system.

features.name: Sales Quote Generation
features.description: The agent automatically prepares sales quotes with items and prices identified from customer inquiries and attaches them to draft replies.
caveats: Quote generation can be skipped if configured to send orders directly instead

features.name: Inbox Connection Configuration
features.description: Users can connect the agent to personal or shared Outlook inboxes, with options to use a dedicated folder for testing instead of the main inbox.
caveats: Shared inbox access depends on user permissions
Dedicated folders recommended when experimenting with real customer emails

features.name: No Review Configuration Option
features.description: Users can configure the agent to skip review for emails from known customers and process them automatically.
caveats: Still requires human review of outgoing email before sending
Only skips review of incoming messages for known customers

features.name: Availability and Capable to Promise Options
features.description: Users can configure whether the agent should process real availability information or use capable to promise functionality.
caveats: Can be toggled on or off based on business needs

features.name: Sales Order Confirmation Generation
features.description: The agent can generate and prepare sales order confirmations instead of just quotes, ready for review and sending to customers.
